newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet for Jul 27-28.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet for Jul 27-28.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy diesel and jet fuel for July 27-28 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 235,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 65,000 barrels of jet fuel.
The tender closes on July 2 and offers will be valid for two days.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought from Shell 250,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel at a 13.5-cent-per-barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes and 50,000 barrels of jet fuel at an 18.5-cent discount, c-and-f Colombo.
The combination cargo was for July 12-13 delivery.
